English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #misleading#whatsappgroups WhatsApp groups initiated by recognised organisations revealed as fraud Misleading Groups of individuals claiming to be employees and agents linked with well-reputed organisations such as Hayleys PLC are engaging in fraudulent acts by creating fake WhatsApp groups, namely, “Hayleys Group 14” to mislead people to engage with them by reviewing movies. by Anonymous | April 30, 2024 Although their ulterior motive is yet unclear, hundreds of individuals have been added to these WhatsApp groups, and the organisation has received numerous customer complaints. When FactSeeker contacted the Hayleys PLC to investigate the matter, an official of the organisation clarified that no such groups were created by the company, nor are the “Admins” of the groups linked with the organisation The official further stated that complaints began to flood in at the beginning of this month. The organisation have complained to the Computer Crimes Investigations Division (CCID) of the Criminal Investigation Division (CID). The Computer Emergency Readiness Team (CERT) has also identified the misleading act and issued a warning. Accordingly, Fact Seeker clarifies that the said fraudulent act is misleading. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
